body:
INCIDENT, 2026-10-29, Termal::Fable2 (the coordinator), owned and disclosed.
At about 03:57:28Z a Bash tool call by Fable2 ran an unintended `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full` in the MAIN checkout C:\github\Personal\TermAl. The run was .git/review-runs/test-452ccd81-4b0c-406e-8053-ee4721056cc0, with owner session-8112.
Cause: shell command substitution. A relay message was built with printf '%s' "…`node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full`…" inside DOUBLE quotes, so bash executed the backticked text. The tool call then hung at the 120 s limit, moved to the background, and the gate ran on.
Impact:
- Its stages (cargo-check, fingerprint tests, then `cargo test` from 04:01:43Z) overlapped B16's pinned live-25 run test-da554d1a (04:00:01–04:06:15Z), which ended 24/1 FAIL. The contention is a first-class hypothesis for that failure.
- It broke the one-Cargo rule at about 32.7 GiB free commit.
Fix: TaskStop on the background task. Stop-Process on Fable2's own orphaned chain only (sh 101208, node test-temp-root 100884, rustup 16824, cargo 41172, test binary 50584), after verifying their ancestry. The run was then settled with `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs recover` as INTERRUPTED; no tests were rerun.
RULE GOING FORWARD: never put backticks or $( ) inside double-quoted shell strings in Bash tool calls. Write message text through a QUOTED heredoc (<<'EOF') or the Write tool, and pass it with --message-file.
